UPSSSC Excise Constable Admit Card 2026 – Full Details

Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the admit card for the Post of Excise Constable posts. This recruitment was released for 820 posts. Applications for the UPSSSC Excise Constable Various Post Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 04 June 2026 to 24 June 2026. The examination is going to conducted on 20 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their UPSSSC Excise Constable Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Measurement : Male
  • Height : 167.6 CM
  • Chest : 80-85 CM
  • Weight : NA
  • Category : Distance
  • Male : 4.8 KM
  • Female : 2.4 KM

How to Check Result

  1. Click on the direct official result link provided below.
  2. Enter your Roll Number / Registration Number and Date of Birth.
  3. Submit the form to view your scorecard on screen.
  4. Download and print a copy of the result for future reference.
